institution: Universidad de Valladolid (UVa) — joint with Universidad de Burgos and Universidad de León
discovery_source: UVa full catalogue enumeration via the site's own study feed https://www.uva.es/ws/estudios.json (the JSON that powers https://www.uva.es/export/sites/uva/2.estudios/2.04.master/2.03.01.oferta/ , which is a JavaScript app and renders no list to a plain fetch), accessed 2026-08-24
notes: INSTITUTION AUDIT — Universidad de Valladolid. The public 'Oferta de Máster' page is a React app and returns no programme list to a normal fetch; the underlying feed at https://www.uva.es/ws/estudios.json lists ALL UVa studies (193 records: 107 grados, 75 under 2.04.master, 1 máster de secundaria, 10 títulos propios). Filtering the master records gives ~69 distinct másteres universitarios plus 1 Erasmus Mundus, 1 double-degree programme and 5 'programa de recorrido sucesivo' grado+máster pathways (which are pathways, not separate titles). Título propio catalogue = 10 records, of which 7 are Máster de Formación Permanente (Derecho Marítimo y Comercio Internacional; Dirección Avanzada y Transformación Digital en Transporte y Logística; Dirección y Gestión de Cooperativas Agroalimentarias x2 editions; Habilidades para la Gestión del Patrimonio Cultural; Neuro-Rehabilitación Avanzada; Ética, Ambiente y Ciudadanía Crítica) — NONE in AI, data science, cloud, audio, music industry or events. One título propio record in the feed is literally titled 'Cambia el titulo aqui' (an unedited CMS placeholder), which is a warning about the feed's data hygiene. // THIS PROGRAMME, verified on the UVa page: 60 ECTS, 1 course, ONLINE modality, 'No habilitante', 27 places total of which only 12 at UVa; Escuela de Ingeniería Informática de Valladolid; joint UVa + Universidad de Burgos + Universidad de León; coordinator Luis Ignacio Jiménez Gil, master.bigdata@uva.es; own site https://www.inf.uva.es/master-online/ ; 'Resolución Renovación Acreditación 2024' PDF published on the page (accreditation renewed 2024 — official). *** RULE-7 TRAP, FLAGGED: the official title is bilingual and the English half reads 'Business Intelligence and Big Data in Cyber-Secure Environments', but UVa's own language field says ESPAÑOL. The programme is NOT taught in English. Do not infer otherwise from the title. *** Content is a genuine X+AB hybrid: Business Intelligence/analytics, Big Data storage and scalable processing, data science and AI methods over massive streams, ETL, visualisation, plus cybersecurity. ENTRY-PROFILE FIT IS GOOD: 'áreas idóneas' explicitly include Ingeniería Informática. Delivery is fully online, which for a non-EU applicant generally does NOT support a Spanish student visa — a decisive practical constraint.
